name: Ship it
description: Ship it: commit what a worktree task left, push its branch, open or update its PR; follow its checks and reviews, fix conflicts with a follow-up, squash-merge the reviewed head and fast-forward the user's checkout.

permissions.ship:track: track a task's repos for Ship it
permissions.ship:view: see what a task would ship
permissions.ship:ship: commit, push and open a pull request
permissions.ship:refresh: ask GitHub about a task's pull requests
permissions.ship:details: read a task's pull requests in full
permissions.ship:attach: attach a pull request to a task
permissions.ship:fix_conflicts: ask a task to merge its base in
permissions.ship:recheck: recheck what a task has to ship
